query: WITH a AS (SELECT sales."StoreKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS av FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT online_sales."StoreKey" AS k, MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS bv FROM online_sales WHERE online_sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND online_sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(a.k,b.k) AS k,a.av,b.bv FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.k=b.k ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 4

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."StoreKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS av FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT online_sales."StoreKey" AS k, MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS bv FROM online_sales WHERE online_sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND online_sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT a.k,a.av,b.bv FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k ORDER BY a.k LIMIT 4
SELECT calendar."CalendarYear",MEASURE(sales.sales_amount),MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) FROM sales CROSS JOIN (calendar CROSS JOIN online_sales) WHERE calendar."CalendarYear"=2007 GROUP BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT store."StoreType" AS k,channel."ChannelName" AS label,MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM store CROSS JOIN sales CROSS JOIN channel WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1,2),r AS (SELECT k,label,v,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v DESC) AS n FROM a) SELECT k,label,v FROM r WHERE n=1 ORDER BY 1,2
note: 两个字符串分组列，排名只用于筛选

query: WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT k,v,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS n FROM a) SELECT n AS position,k AS grouping_key,v AS amount FROM b ORDER BY n LIMIT 2

SELECT AVG(CAST(b-a AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM (VALUES (TIMESTAMP '2007-02-01 00:00:00',TIMESTAMP '2007-02-03 00:00:00'),(TIMESTAMP '2007-02-02 00:00:00',TIMESTAMP '2007-02-03 00:00:00')) t(a,b)
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION),x) FROM (VALUES (1.0),(2.0)) a(x)

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT k,CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE v END FROM a ORDER BY k

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT k,AVG(v),MIN(v),MAX(v),COUNT(*) FROM a GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1),b AS (SELECT k,v FROM a) SELECT a.k,a.v AS av,b.v AS bv FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k ORDER BY a.k

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1),b AS (SELECT k,v FROM a WHERE k <= 2) SELECT a.k,a.v AS av,b.v AS bv FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k ORDER BY a.k

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN k <= 2 THEN v ELSE 0 END) AS lo,SUM(CASE WHEN k > 2 THEN v ELSE 0 END) AS hi FROM a
